title: Canonical - Equity Compensation Issuance Transaction
description: Canonical (hypothetical OCF) representation of an equity-compensation issuance. Field-for-field equivalent to OCF's TX_EQUITY_COMPENSATION_ISSUANCE except that the DAG-based vesting_terms_id is replaced with vesting_template_id (refs a canonical VestingScheduleTemplate). The template's per-grant vesting start date is carried here as vesting_start_date; any named-event condition on a statement is witnessed by TX_CANONICAL_VESTING_EVENT.

comments.description: Unstructured text comments related to and stored for the object.

date.description: Date on which the issuance transaction occurred. Distinct from the vesting commencement date, which is carried separately as vesting_start_date.

security_id.description: Identifier for the security created by this issuance. Other transactions (vesting event, exercise, cancellation, etc.) reference this id.

stakeholder_id.description: Identifier of the stakeholder holding legal title to the security.

board_approval_date.description: Date of board approval for the security, when applicable.

stockholder_approval_date.description: Date of stockholder approval for the security, when applicable.

consideration_text.description: Unstructured text description of consideration provided in exchange for the issuance.

security_law_exemptions.description: Security law exemptions (and applicable jurisdictions) for this security.

stock_plan_id.description: If the security was issued from a stock plan, the plan's id. Plan-less options are valid and omit this field.

stock_class_id.description: The stock class the security exercises/settles into. Important for plan-less options and plans that support multiple share classes.

compensation_type.description: The kind of equity compensation (OPTION_NSO, OPTION_ISO, OPTION, RSU, CSAR, SSAR). Determines which type-specific fields are required.

option_grant_type.description: If the security is an option, what kind. Retained from OCF for compatibility; in OCF this has been incorporated into CompensationType.

quantity.description: Number of shares subject to this security.

exercise_price.description: Required for option compensation types. The price per share at which the option can be exercised.

base_price.description: Required for stock appreciation right compensation types (CSAR, SSAR). The base price used to calculate appreciation.

early_exercisable.description: If true, the security is exercisable prior to completion of vesting; the schedule then governs a right-of-repurchase lapse rather than the right-to-exercise.

vesting_start_date.description: The per-grant vesting commencement date — the anchor every statement of the referenced template grids from. Required whenever vesting_template_id is present and always supplied with the grant: when the real commencement date is not yet known (a contingent start), a far-future placeholder date (e.g. 9999-12-31) is supplied rather than omitting the field or modeling the start as an event. Lives on the issuance, not the template, because the template is reusable across grants. Populates Carta's Vesting.startDate.

vesting_template_id.description: Identifier of the canonical VestingScheduleTemplate the security is subject to. If neither vesting_template_id nor vestings is present, the security is fully vested at issuance. The template's statements anchor to vesting_start_date (carried on this same transaction); a statement may additionally carry an event_condition whose firing is recorded by TX_CANONICAL_VESTING_EVENT.

vestings.description: Optional materialized projection of exact vesting dates and amounts (the projection layer). A grant may be described by the declarative template (vesting_template_id), by this imperative event list, or by both; when both are present an external tool confirms they agree.

expiration_date.description: Expiration date of the security, or null if it does not expire.

termination_exercise_windows.description: Exercise periods applicable after a termination, by reason.
